label: Lenalidomide
intro: Lenalidomide is cleared mainly by the kidneys, so renal function dominates its special-population evidence. The platform holds the dedicated renal study CC-5013-PK-001 (from the EMA assessment), two population PK models with renal covariates (Hughes 2019, Kim 2026), their locked outside checks against that study, and their enforced scopes.

Hughes 2019: clearance scales with creatinine clearance as (CrCl / 90 mL/min) to this power (with fat-free mass).
Kim 2026: clearance rises exponentially with eGFR; coefficient per mL/min/1.73 m2 (estimate) around a reference of 46.92.
Hughes 2019 creatinine clearance bands and evidence tiers on the platform (36-50 mL/min is flagged: the model under-predicted the moderate group about 2-fold).

value.band_note: Normal (> 80 mL/min) and mild (50-80) groups: exposure consistent with study CC-5013-PK-001 in all four scenarios (external_check_report).
Moderate group (30-50 mL/min): the model under-predicted exposure about 2.1-fold (ratio to normal 2.2-fold) in all four scenarios (external_check_report). Read the curve as substantially too low.

kidney.text: Kim 2026 eGFR bands and evidence tiers on the platform (11.1-30 is flagged: the model under-predicted the severe group about 1.3-fold).

value.band_note: Mild group (creatinine clearance 50-80 mL/min): ratio to normal consistent in all seven scenarios; normal-group exposure consistent in six of seven (external_check_report). The study groups are defined by creatinine clearance; Kim's covariate is indexed eGFR, so band edges are approximate.

Moderate group (30-50 mL/min): ratio to normal consistent in the primary scenario but not in every scenario; absolute exposure under-predicted about 1.3-fold in six of seven (secondary endpoint) (external_check_report).

Severe group (< 30 mL/min): ratio to normal under-predicted about 1.3-fold in the primary scenario (five of seven scenarios); half-life reproduced (applicability_findings renal-under-prediction-severe). Read the curve as possibly somewhat low.
